Practice: What are pure / impure functions? ​

Status: outstanding learner practice. Author checks do not complete these requirements.

Prerequisite: study the worked lesson and its linked foundations. Apply these focused cases to P-328/P-329/P-330; retain only the cases relevant to the chosen increment.

1 Scope and observable criteria ​

Exercise acceptance: freeze plain input records/array, prove repeat totals and unchanged inputs, reject invalid/overflow cents, and verify publishTotal calls its supplied sink once with the same total on repeated calls. Show that a deterministic sink effect is still impure; changing an external clock/random value is another distinct impurity source. Record the domain/alias assumptions before memoizing; learner practice remains required.

2 Evidence ​

Record source revision, runtime/browser versions, expected versus observed result, one reproduced failure, correction and retest. Include exact commands or input sequence and artifacts. Mark unperformed keyboard, screen-reader, zoom, device and integration checks explicitly. Never record a supplied example as your completed practice.
